name: Amazon
desc:
Spanish Bilingual Technical CS Associate, Blink | 17.21 - 24.51 | inbound calls 
Company: Amazon (Blink)

What Your Day Will Look Like:
You’ll help Blink customers solve problems with their home security cameras and subscriptions. Most of the customer contact is inbound phone calls, with email support too. You’ll ask questions, walk customers through fixes for camera, Wi-Fi, home network, or mobile device problems, and explain how to use the products. You’ll record what you tried, pass along repeat problems, and suggest ways to improve the product or support process. You may also help during product launches and coordinate with other support teams.

What the job is really hiring for: A Spanish bilingual customer service representative with strong technical troubleshooting skills who can explain solutions clearly and work a flexible schedule.

Calls and data work:
• Inbound or outbound calls: Inbound calls and email support. The posting does not describe outbound sales calls.
• Data entry and tracking: You’ll document customer issues and solutions. Some analysis or process improvement is mentioned, but the posting does not describe this as a data-entry-heavy job.
• Sales: No sales or upselling duties are listed.
• Technical work: Troubleshooting Blink devices and customers’ home networking and mobile configurations.
assessment: Yes, expect an assessment after applying or after initial contact with recruiter. Expect typing, grammar, behavioral, and internet speed assessments.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

**Education Minimum:** No minimum education requirement is stated in the posting.

**Required Experience:** At least 2 years of customer service experience.

**Preferred Experience:** Experience working rotating shifts and variable days off is preferred. No additional preferred experience is stated.


**Required Skills:**

- Fluency in Spanish, including speaking, writing, and reading
- Customer service and technical troubleshooting ability
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Ability to work a flexible schedule, including weekends, nights, and holidays
- Ability to help customers troubleshoot home networking and mobile device configurations
- Clear communication, active listening, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills
- Ability to document solutions and share customer trends or product issues


**Best Fit:**

**This role is ideal for someone who:**

- Is fluent in Spanish and English and has at least two years of customer service experience.
- Enjoys solving technical problems involving cameras, Wi-Fi, home networks, or mobile devices.
- Can explain troubleshooting steps patiently by phone and email.
- Can work a flexible schedule that may include weekends, nights, or holidays.

**Not a Good Fit for someone who:**

- Is not fluent in Spanish.
- Has less than two years of customer service experience.
- Is uncomfortable troubleshooting technology with customers by phone.
- Needs a fixed weekday schedule without nights, weekends, or holiday shifts.
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process: Apply online through Amazon Jobs. The posting does not specify application materials beyond the application or list assessment and interview stages.

Top 10 Resume Keywords:
• Spanish-English bilingual customer support
• Technical support
• Inbound call handling
• Home security cameras
• Wi-Fi and home networking troubleshooting
• Mobile device configuration
• Customer advocacy
• Critical thinking and problem solving
• Case documentation
• Customer experience improvement

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
• How do you explain a technical fix to a customer who is not comfortable with technology?
• Tell me about a difficult customer issue you solved by troubleshooting step by step.
• What steps would you take to diagnose a Blink camera that will not connect to Wi-Fi?
• How have you used Spanish to help a customer understand a product or service?
• How do you handle schedule changes or rotating shifts while maintaining reliable attendance?

Pay, Schedule, Benefits, and Other Details:
Pay: $17.21–$24.51 per hour for Oklahoma.
Schedule: Full-time schedule options include 4x10 or 5x8, with operating hours across Sunday–Saturday. Flexibility may include weekends, nights, and holidays.
Benefits: EAP, mental health support, medical advice line, and 401(k) matching starting Day 1. Full benefit details and eligibility are on Amazon’s benefits page.
Customer contact: Inbound phone calls and email.
Language: Fluent Spanish is required.
